title: Google opens Genie 4 for interactive world simulation
summary: Google DeepMind has made Genie 4 available in Project Genie to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers, while access through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio remains limited to early-access partners.
body:
## A world model becomes a product
Google DeepMind has made Genie 4 available in Project Genie to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. The model generates interactive environments that users can navigate and modify in real time with keyboard controls and natural-language prompts.

Genie 4 combines Gemini-family capabilities with a world simulator designed to preserve scene continuity as events unfold. Google says it can generate photorealistic environments, fluid movement and native audio. Users can change weather, move the camera or introduce people and objects while the system adapts the scene between interactions.

The release also points toward robotics. DeepMind says it is exploring Genie 4 with Gemini Robotics: Gemini 4 Argon can create multi-step plans whose captions are passed into Genie 4, turning the simulator into an experimental environment for robotics research. Generated video and audio carry SynthID watermarking.

## Still a controlled preview
The launch is narrower than a general-purpose game engine. Google lists visual drift, weak object permanence, complex physical interactions, inaccurate real-world locations, poor text rendering, audio-accuracy issues and limited interaction duration as current constraints. Continuous interaction is presently around one minute. Genie 4 began as a research preview for trusted testers; Project Genie access is now available to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers, while Gemini API and Google AI Studio access is described as early access for partners.

## Why it matters
Genie 4 moves world models from research demonstrations toward a user-facing platform. If the system can become more persistent and physically consistent, it could provide cheaper synthetic environments for robotics, agent evaluation and interactive entertainment. For now, the one-minute horizon and scene drift mean the product is best understood as an early simulation layer, not a dependable replacement for a game engine or physical training environment.

**Uncle Cat take:** SynthID is a meaningful deployment choice, but Genie 4’s one-minute interaction ceiling remains the hard limit on its current robotics promise.
title_zh: 谷歌开放 Genie 4，实时生成可交互虚拟世界
summary_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 已在 Project Genie 向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放 Genie 4；Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 目前仍仅面向早期访问合作伙伴。
body_zh:
## 世界模型开始面向用户
谷歌 DeepMind 已在 Project Genie 向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放 Genie 4。该模型能够生成可交互环境，用户可通过键盘和自然语言实时探索并修改场景。

Genie 4 将 Gemini 系列的能力与世界模拟器结合，试图在事件连续发生时保持场景连贯。谷歌称，它支持更逼真的画面、流畅运动和原生音频。用户可以改变天气、移动镜头，或加入人物和物体，系统会在交互之间调整世界状态。

这次发布也连接到机器人研究。DeepMind 表示，正在探索将 Genie 4 与 Gemini Robotics 结合：Gemini 4 Argon 可以制定多步骤行动计划，再把文字描述传递给 Genie 4，使其成为机器人研究中的实验性模拟环境。模型生成的视频与音频均带有 SynthID 水印。

## 仍是受控预览
Genie 4 还远未成为通用游戏引擎。谷歌列出的限制包括画面漂移、物体持续性不足、复杂物理交互不稳定、现实地点还原不准确、文字渲染欠佳、音频准确性仍有限，以及交互时间有限。目前连续交互约为一分钟。Genie 4 最初以研究预览形式向可信测试者开放；目前 Project Genie 已向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放，而 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 仍被官方描述为面向合作伙伴的早期访问。

## 为什么重要
Genie 4 将世界模型从研究演示推进到面向用户的平台。如果它能进一步提升持久性和物理一致性，未来可为机器人训练、智能体评测和互动娱乐提供更便宜的合成环境。但在当前阶段，一分钟交互上限和场景漂移仍意味着它更像早期模拟层，而不是可靠的游戏引擎或实体训练环境替代品。

**猫叔判断：** SynthID 水印体现了部署诚意，但一分钟交互上限仍是 Genie 4 机器人愿景的硬约束。

sources.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation

cat_take_zh: SynthID值得肯定，但一分钟交互仍卡住Genie 4的机器人愿景
cat_take_en: SynthID is thoughtful deployment, but Genie 4’s one-minute ceiling still constrains its robotics ambition.
